summary.text: Dalton Bradford is the Democratic candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 13 in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 2 Democratic primary.
According to his campaign website, he is from Polson and a descendant of the Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes.

paragraphs.text: Dalton Bradford says on his campaign website that his family has been in Montana and Polson for many generations, that he is a descendant of the Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes, and that he graduated from Polson High School.
He states that he has never run for or been directly involved in an election before this campaign.
He describes his campaign as one that emphasizes bipartisanship and listening to constituents rather than party-line voting.
